title: BFS Algorithm
question: WAP to implement BFS algorithm. The graph should also be drawn in the lab report.
theory: Breadth First Search explores the graph level by level. It uses a queue, marks each visited vertex, and is suitable for finding the shortest path in an unweighted graph.
The sample graph starts at A and searches for G. The BFS path is A -> B -> E -> G.
algorithm: Insert the start vertex into a queue and mark it visited.
Remove the front vertex, visit it, and enqueue all unvisited adjacent vertices.
Store parent links when a vertex is discovered so the final path can be reconstructed.
Stop when the goal is found or when the queue becomes empty.

title: Display Name in Prolog
question: Write a program to display your name in Prolog.
theory: The write/1 predicate prints a term, and nl/0 moves the output to the next line. This program prints student details and the lab number.
code:
print_identity :-
    write('Name: {NAME}'), nl,
    write('Roll No: {ROLL}'), nl,
    write('Lab Number: Lab II - Display Name'), nl.

:- initialization(print_identity).
